title: When the Choir Falls
author: Coral Marchetti
blurb: Marguerite Oyelaran, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
